title: AssetResponseEvent
description: Schema for Service Manager message SM9. This event is published by the Service Manager in response to GetAssetCommand and returns a reference to the requested Asset entity.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be assetResponseEvent.

originator.description: Property. Component that generated the response event.

messageId.description: Property. Unique identifier of this response message.

correlationId.description: Property. Identifier used to correlate this response event with the corresponding GetAssetCommand.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the Asset response event was generated.

asset.description: Relationship. Asset entity returned by the Service Manager.
